label: NOTE: this set covers the four members that close V90ConstellationDesigner -- adjustConstellationsPower, adjustConstellationsToNewK, constellationDesign and process -- and is caught by t_v90cdadjust. The earlier members of the same source file have their own sets; a mutation here that those catch as well is still recorded against this one, because what is being asked is whether THIS test would see it.
note: The two argument-drop mutations and the 32-bit kMax are the ones the fixture was built for: each is a reading a plausible source produces and that no ordinary random fill separates from the object's. See the header of test/unit/t_v90cdadjust.cpp. NOT REPRESENTED HERE: the constellationSize > 128 half of adjustConstellationsToNewK's failure test, which the test cannot drive because the object writes one past the row there and then fails to terminate -- docs/deviations.md D351 and D352, and the test's own header.

label: process computes kMax in 32 bits, which is the obvious spelling -- EXPECTED TO SURVIVE
find:
s = (unsigned char)(6 - mappingParams->shaperSR);
		kMax = (unsigned char)(42 - s);
replace:
s = (unsigned char)(6 - mappingParams->shaperSR);
		kMax = (unsigned int)(36 + mappingParams->shaperSR) + (s - s);
note: The two readings differ only for a shaperSR above 219 or below -36, and there the `d > 42` clamp two statements later takes both to word_0 = 42 and k = shaperSR + 36: d is `k - shaperSR + 6` unsigned, k is at most maxK which is at most 42 over six constellations of at most 128 points, so a shaperSR above 219 needs k >= 213 to keep d under 43 and one below -36 makes d at least k + 43.  Provably unobservable through this member, and the source comment and finding F3403 say so.

label: process clamps the constellation table's d at 41 rather than 42
note: Recorded NOT CAUGHT.  It differs only where `d` is exactly 42, and the two arms then agree on `word_0` (42 either way) and differ only in `k`, which is printed and not stored -- so the loud group would have to land a composed trial on `maxK == shaperSR + 36` exactly.  None of the sixty-one does.

label: process rounds byte_08 up at 4 rather than above it
note: Recorded NOT CAUGHT.  It differs only where `42 - word_0` is exactly 4, which is a `word_0` of 38, and every composed trial's design lands on the 42 clamp or well under it.

note: `(powerLadderIndex <= 21) ? powerLadderIndex : 22` and `(powerLadderIndex <= 22) ? powerLadderIndex : 22` agree everywhere: below 22 both give powerLadderIndex, at 22 both give 22, above 22 both give 22. note: Recorded NOT CAUGHT.  `beforeK - startK` is `realK - maxK`, and realK adds 1e-9f to a quotient of two logarithms, so it lands exactly on a float UP_ROUND_K only if the product of the six lengths is zero -- which the fixture cannot drive, because the getPower that follows would divide by that same zero (D356).  The strictness of the comparison is read from `ja` at 0x4bb67 and is not differentially observable.

		 __builtin_abs((int)((x87_fsqrt((long double)first)
				      - (long double)(int)x87_fsqrt(

				     * 1000.0f)));

label: adjustConstellationsPower takes the sqrt line's sign from the ROOT and not from the power (only the loud group can see this)
note: Recorded NOT CAUGHT.  The two differ only for a negative power, where the root is the indefinite NaN and an ordered compare against it takes the other arm; every power this sweep produces is a sum of squares times non-negative fractions.  The reading is from `fcomps 0x38(%esp)` at 0x4ae74, which compares against the STORED POWER and not the root -- the disassembly is the evidence, and this entry records that no input adds to it.
